_comment: TODO §12.3 -- continuous-signing models, gislr.1.models.continuous.ipynb. Every hyperparameter lives here, never in a cell. Runs inherit `shared` and may deviate only via `overrides` naming a key that exists in `shared` (sb.recognize.continuous.train enforces this).

C1.notes: Primary model: GRU, per-frame gloss+null cross-entropy + sign-boundary BCE, all 250 glosses.

C2.notes: C1 with an LSTM body: the architecture comparison.

C3.notes: C1 trained with CTC (blank = null) instead of per-frame targets: the alignment-free reference real continuous video would need. Its boundary head is untrained.

Copen.notes: C1's recipe with 20 seeded glosses held out of training entirely (masked in the head); the model TODO §12.4 teaches new signs to.

P1.notes: C1's recipe on the 130 phonological features only (feature pipeline phono130_v1; streams composed in feature space by sb.recognize.continuous.phono; evaluated on GISLR-Sentences through the real extractor). TODO §3.10 -> §12.3.
